sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach come into this fixture off the back of a recent loss but with a strong underlying record of seven wins from their last ten matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just four points and are winless in their last five games, making this a favorable matchup for the league leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place on 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points despite recent losses, host Eccleshall at home on Saturday. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points and in form with three straight wins, visit Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) face Foley Meir at home, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter sitting 15th and on a run of five consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills, with both teams battling mid-table inconsistency. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home seeking to climb away from the lower half, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle between two struggling sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with the latter pointless at the bottom of the league. A midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social visit Wednesfield Community at 19:45.
